description: This file is a shell script designed to run a series of tests on Git's 'git describe' functionality. It contains setup code, multiple test cases for various 'git describe' options, and checks for edge cases and error conditions. The script uses test helper functions to automate validation of 'git describe' output against expected results, covering scenarios such as tags, branches, tags with special characters, submodules, and boundary conditions.

methods.name: check_describe
methods.description: Function to invoke 'git describe' with given options and compare output to expected value, supporting success and failure cases.
